_approach: A call-and-response mandelão variant that mimics the shouted vocal exchange in rim/tom hits: a rim figure 'calls' on the & of 2 and the low tom 'answers' on the & of 4, over the same minimal kick, embodying mandelão's hypnotic repetition and gritty saturation on massive sound systems. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
